z-m-34-13.title: k da ke sa layuka biyu su zama masu layi ɗaya: 2 da −2 duka?
z-m-34-13.topic: Ma'aunan siffofi: sharadin layuka biyu su zama masu layi ɗaya, da kuma su yi layi ɗaya daidai (layuka masu harafi)
z-m-34-13.goal: Bincika ko duk ƙimomin k da aka samo ta amfani da sharadin gangaren daidai suna samar da layuka masu layi ɗaya da gaske, ware yanayin da suka yi layi ɗaya daidai, sannan ka bayyana cewa amsar na iya dogara da ma'anar kalmar layi ɗaya.
z-m-34-13.material: Akwai layi l₁: kx + 2y = 4 da layi l₂: 2x + ky = 4 (k lamba ce ta ainihi). A cikin wannan aiki, 'masu layi ɗaya' yana nufin layuka biyu mabambanta da ba sa haɗuwa; idan ma'aunai biyun layi ɗaya ne, suna 'kan layi ɗaya daidai' kuma ba a kiransu masu layi ɗaya ba. Harin ya nemo ƙimomin k da layukan biyu suke zama masu layi ɗaya kamar yadda aka nuna a ƙasa. (An lissafa layukan daga 1.)
z-m-34-13.thinking.0: Bincika matakin tabbatarwa na ƙarshe a warwarewar
z-m-34-13.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiro matsaloli da suka cika sharadin da kanka
z-m-34-13.thinking.2: Bambanta yanayin da amsa ke dogara ga ma'anar kalma
z-m-34-13.prereq.1: Gangaren layi da sharadin layuka biyu su zama masu layi ɗaya
z-m-34-13.prereq.2: Ma'anar layuka biyu da suke yin layi ɗaya daidai
z-m-34-13.s.s1.hint.0: Saka k = 2 da k = −2 cikin ma'aunai biyun, sannan ka rubuta ko layukan da suka wakilta iri ɗaya ne ko sun bambanta.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin waɗanne layuka ne sharadin 'gangarensu daidai ne' ya haɗa: masu layi ɗaya da waɗanda suke layi ɗaya daidai.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.line.0: Idan layuka biyu masu layi ɗaya ne, gangarensu daidai ne.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.line.1: Gangaren l₁ shi ne −k/2, gangaren l₂ kuma shi ne −2/k.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.line.2: Daga −k/2 = −2/k ana samun k² = 4, don haka k = 2 ko k = −2.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka ƙimomin k da suke sa layukan biyun su zama masu layi ɗaya su ne 2 da −2.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ba daidai ba ne. Idan k = 2, duka ma'aunai sun zama 2x + 2y = 4, wato layi ɗaya ne (sun yi daidai). Bisa ƙa'idar wannan aiki, layukan da suka yi daidai ba layuka masu layi ɗaya ba ne, saboda haka k = −2 ne kaɗai yanayin layukan layi ɗaya. (−2x + 2y = 4 da 2x − 2y = 4 sun zama y = x + 2 da y = x − 2, layuka daban-daban masu layi ɗaya.)
z-m-34-13.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri nau'i-nau'i 3 daban-daban na (a, b) domin layukan ax + y = 1 da 4x + by = 2 su zama layuka daban-daban masu layi ɗaya. (Dole ne ƙimar a ta bambanta a kowace ƙungiya.)
z-m-34-13.s.s2.hint.0: Ka daidaita ma'aunin y a cikin ma'aunai biyun, sannan ka kwatanta ma'aunan x da kuma ƙayyadaddun lambobi.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.hint.1: Bayan ka samo nau'i-nau'i mai gangara iri ɗaya, ka duba ko ɗaya daga cikin ma'aunai ninki ne na ɗayan ta wani tsayayyen adadi.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.hint.2: Canja a zuwa 1, 4, −1 da sauransu, sannan ka daidaita b da su.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.ok.c1: Rabon ma'aunan ya dace, saboda haka gangarorin sun yi daidai.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.fail.c1: Gangarorin ba su yi daidai ba. Ka rubuta gangarorin layukan biyu da a da b, sannan ka daidaita su.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.ok.c2: Ma'aunai biyun ba layi ɗaya ba ne.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.fail.c2: A wannan nau'i-nau'in, ma'aunai biyun layi ɗaya ne (sun yi daidai). Nau'i-nau'i na layuka da suka yi daidai ba layi ɗaya ba ne.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.explain: Idan ab = 4 kuma a ≠ 2, layukan daban-daban ne masu layi ɗaya. Misali, (1, 4), (4, 1), (−1, −4), (8, 0.5). Ga (2, 2), ma'aunai biyun su ne 2x + y = 1 da 4x + 2y = 2, layi ɗaya ne, saboda haka ba layi ɗaya ba ne.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.prompt: Ka rubuta dalilin da ya sa akwai nau'i-nau'i da suka cika ab = 4 amma ba sa samar da layuka masu layi ɗaya.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.hint.0: Saka nau'i-nau'i mai ab = 4 a cikin ma'aunai biyun, sannan ka duba ko ninka dukkan ɓangarorin ma'auni ɗaya da wani adadi zai sa ta zama daidai da ɗayar.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nemo ƙimar (a, b) da ke sa ɗaya ta zama ninkin ɗayar.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Na duba ko ma'aunai biyun a misalina layi ɗaya ne da gaske?
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Na bayyana bambancin 'layuka masu layi ɗaya' da 'layukan da suka yi daidai' da kalmomin kaina?
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan a = 2, b = 2, to l₁ ita ce 2x + y = 1, l₂ kuma ita ce 4x + 2y = 2; wannan ninkin ma'auni ɗaya ne, saboda haka layi ɗaya ne. Layukan da suka yi wa juna daidai ba layuka daban-daban masu layi ɗaya ba ne, don haka a cire su.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan a = 2, b = 2, layukan biyu sun rufe juna gaba ɗaya kuma sun yi daidai. Layukan da suka yi daidai ba wai ba sa haɗuwa ba ne; suna haɗuwa a wurare marasa iyaka.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.prompt: Wasu littattafan karatu suna ɗaukar 'layuka biyu da suka yi daidai' a matsayin layuka masu layi ɗaya. Bisa wannan ma'anar, waɗanne ƙimar k ne ke sa l₁: kx + 2y = 4 da l₂: 2x + ky = 4 su zama masu layi ɗaya?
z-m-34-13.s.s3.hint.0: Ka rubuta ko ma'aunai biyun layi ɗaya ne idan k = 2, da abin da zai faru bisa ma'anar da ta haɗa layukan da suka yi daidai cikin masu layi ɗaya.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.hint.1: Zana yadda layukan biyun suke idan k = 0.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.o.a: k = −2 kaɗai: amsar iri ɗaya ce ko wace ma'ana aka bi
z-m-34-13.s.s3.r.a: Idan an kuma ɗauki layukan da suka yi daidai a matsayin masu layi ɗaya, dole ne a ƙirga yanayin k = 2, inda suka zama layi ɗaya, a matsayin layi ɗaya.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.o.b: k = 2 kaɗai: idan k = −2, layukan biyun suna haɗuwa
z-m-34-13.s.s3.r.b: Saka k = −2 a cikin ma'aunai, sannan ka duba ko layukan biyun suna haɗuwa.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.o.c: k = 2 da k = −2 duka: ya danganta da ma'anar da aka bi
z-m-34-13.s.s3.o.d: A haɗa k = 0 ma: ba ta da gangara, saboda haka layukan suna layi ɗaya
z-m-34-13.s.s3.r.d: Idan k = 0, layi ɗaya yana kwance, ɗayan kuma a tsaye. Ka duba ko layukan biyun suna haɗuwa.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.explain: Idan an haɗa layukan da suka yi daidai cikin masu layi ɗaya, k = 2 da k = −2 duka suna samar da layuka masu layi ɗaya. Bisa ma'anar da ta ware layukan da suka yi daidai, k = −2 kaɗai. Maganin iri ɗaya zai ba da amsoshi daban-daban bisa ƙa'idar da aka bi, saboda haka ka duba ma'anar da ke cikin tambayar.

z-m-34-05.title: Idan gangaren yana tsakanin gangaren zuwa ƙarshen sashe biyun, shin layin zai haɗu da sashen?
z-m-34-05.topic: Ma'aunan siffofi: sharadin da layi ta maki ke haɗuwa da sashe (zangon gangare)
z-m-34-05.goal: Gwada da'awar 'tsakanin gangaren zuwa ƙarshen sashe biyun' da takamaiman gangare don gina misalin da ya karyata ta, sannan ka faɗi zangon gangaren da suke haɗuwa da amsa cikakkiya har da layin da ba shi da gangare.
z-m-34-05.material: A kan faifan haɗin gwiwar akwai maki P(2, 0) da sashe AB. A(0, 3), B(5, 3), kuma sashe AB, har da ƙarshen biyun, shi ne ɓangaren y = 3 inda x yake daga 0 zuwa 5. Kana son nemo zangon m da layi l mai ratsa P kuma gangarenta m za ta haɗu da sashe AB. Seorin ya ce, "Gangaren layin daga P zuwa A −3/2 ne, daga P zuwa B kuma 1 ne. Saboda haka idan −3/2 ≤ m ≤ 1 ne zai haɗu da sashen."
z-m-34-05.thinking.0: Gwada ra'ayi na gama-gari da ƙimomi takamaimai
z-m-34-05.thinking.1: Nemo iyakokin zangon biyu ba tare da barin ko ɗaya ba
z-m-34-05.thinking.2: Bincika keɓantattun yanayi kamar layi marar gangare
z-m-34-05.prereq.1: Ma'aunin layin da ke ratsa maki mai gangare m
z-m-34-05.prereq.2: Ma'anar layi da ke haɗuwa da sashe (har da ƙarshen)
z-m-34-05.s.s1.prompt: Kana son gwada ko da'awar Seorin daidai ce. Wace hanya ce ta fi zama abin dogaro?
z-m-34-05.s.s1.hint.0: Zana P(2, 0) da sashe AB a kan faifan haɗin gwiwar, sannan ka zana layukan daga P zuwa A da kuma zuwa B.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi gangare ɗaya a cikin zangon da da'awar ta ambata, sannan ka zana wannan layin.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.o.a: Bincika layukan da suka ratsa ƙarshen A da B kaɗai, ga m = −3/2 da m = 1
z-m-34-05.s.s1.r.a: Layukan da suka ratsa ƙarshen sashe biyun a bayyane suke haɗuwa da sashen. Wannan ba ya gwada ƙimomin cikin zangon da da'awar ta ambata.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.o.b: Zana hoto na kusan-kusan, idan kuma ya yi kama da yana tsakanin ƙarshen biyun, ci gaba
z-m-34-05.s.s1.r.b: Hasashe kaɗai ba zai gaya maka ko ƙima a cikin zangon za ta haɗu da sashen da gaske ba. Dole ka saka wata ƙima takamaimai ka bincika.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.o.c: Zaɓi ƙima guda a cikin zangon da da'awar ta yarda da shi, sannan ka bincika ko wannan layin yana haɗuwa da sashen
z-m-34-05.s.s1.r.c: Da'awar tana cewa 'duk abin da ke cikin zangon yana aiki', don haka idan ko ƙima guda a cikinsa ba ta aiki, da'awar ta rushe. Gwada da ƙima a cikin zangon ita ce hanya kai tsaye mafi dacewa.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.o.d: Rubuta 'zangon gangare koyaushe yana tsakanin gangaren zuwa ƙarshen sashe biyun' sannan ka ci gaba
z-m-34-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka haddace shi a matsayin ƙa'ida ta gama-gari. Ba ka bincika ko tana daidai ga wannan matsayin P da sashen ba.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.explain: Da'awar tana cewa 'ga kowane m da ke cikin zangon, layin zai haɗu'. Idan ka zaɓi ƙima guda a ciki, kuma layin bai haɗu ba, da'awar ba daidai ba ce. Misali, za ka iya gwada m = 0.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da ƙimomin m guda 4 daban-daban waɗanda layin mai gangare m zai haɗu da sashe AB. Gwada ƙimomi a ciki da wajen zangon Seorin.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bayyana ta fuskar m ƙididdigar x a wurin da layin y = m(x − 2) yake da y = 3, sannan ka bincika ko x ɗin yana tsakanin 0 da 5.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ware yanayin da m yake tabbatacce da mara kyau, shigar da ƙimomi ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan ka yi jadawalin ko layin yana haɗuwa.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Layin y = m(x − 2) yana haɗuwa da sashe AB (har da ƙarshen sashe).
z-m-34-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Layin mai wannan gangare ba ya haɗuwa da sashe AB. Bincika ƙididdigar x idan y = 3 ne don ganin ko layin da sashen sun haɗu a wani wuri.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.explain: Yana haɗuwa idan m ≤ −3/2 ko m ≥ 1. Tsakanin −3/2 da 1 (misali 0, 0.5, −1), ba ya haɗuwa. Zangon da Seorin ya bayar ba 'zangon da suke haɗuwa' ba ne, sai dai 'zangon da ba sa haɗuwa'.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Ka yi amfani da takamaiman ƙimar m guda ɗaya don bayyana dalilin da zangon Seorin (−3/2 ≤ m ≤ 1) ba daidai ba ne.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Zaɓi gangare ɗaya a cikin zangon, saka y = 3 cikin y = m(x − 2), sannan ka nemo x.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Kwatanta ko x ɗin da ka samu yana cikin zangon x na sashen (0 zuwa 5).
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Na saka ƙimar da na yi amfani da ita cikin ma'aunin layin don gwadawa da gaske kuwa?
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Na wuce cewa zangon 'ba daidai ba ne' har na bayyana wane gefe ne yake daidai kuwa?
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan m = 0, layin shi ne x-axis ɗin kansa, saboda haka ba ya haɗuwa da sashen da ke kan y = 3. Ƙima ce a cikin zangon amma duk da haka ba ya haɗuwa, saboda haka ra'ayin farko ba daidai ba ne.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan m = −1, y = −(x − 2) yana da x = −1 idan y = 3, kuma wannan yana wajen sashen. Ko da gangaren yana tsakanin gangaren ƙarshen biyu, layin yana haɗuwa a wajen sashen.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.prompt: Ka yi la'akari da dukkan layukan da suka ratsa P (har da layin marar gangare, x = 2). Ta yaya za ka bayyana layukan da suke haɗuwa da sashe AB?
z-m-34-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo haɗin gwiwar wurin da layin x = 2 ya ratsa sashe AB.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.hint.1: Haɗa shi da zangon m da ka bincika a matakin baya, sannan ka rubuta sakamakon a jimla guda.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.o.a: −3/2 ≤ m ≤ 1, kuma layin marar gangare, x = 2, ba ya haɗuwa
z-m-34-05.s.s3.r.a: Ka riga ka bincika a baya cewa ƙimomi a cikin wannan zangon ba sa haɗuwa. Zangon yana ɗaya gefen.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.o.b: m ≤ −3/2 ko m ≥ 1, kuma layin marar gangare, x = 2, shi ma yana haɗuwa
z-m-34-05.s.s3.o.c: m ≤ −3/2 ko m ≥ 1, kuma layin marar gangare, x = 2, ba ya haɗuwa
z-m-34-05.s.s3.r.c: Zangon gangaren daidai ne. Ka bincika da kanka ko layin x = 2 yana haɗuwa da sashe AB.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.o.d: Yana haɗuwa ga kowane m, kuma layin marar gangare ma yana haɗuwa
z-m-34-05.s.s3.r.d: Bincika ko layin mai m = 0 yana haɗuwa da sashen.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.explain: x = 2 da y = 3 suna haɗuwa a maki (2, 3), kuma wannan maki yana kan sashe AB (0 ≤ 2 ≤ 5). Saboda haka layukan da m ≤ −3/2 ko m ≥ 1 suke da su, da layi mai tsaye x = 2, duk suna haɗuwa da sashen. Idan aka duba layukan da ke da gangare kawai, yana da sauƙi a rasa wannan layin.

z-m-34-10.title: Me kake bukatar sani game da maki C domin a kayyade faɗin alwatika?
z-m-34-10.topic: Daidaiton siffofi: faɗin alwatika da sharuddan matsayin maki (wadatar bayanai)
z-m-34-10.goal: Ka tsara bayanin da ake bukata game da maki da wanda bai wadatar ba domin a kayyade faɗin alwatika, sannan ka bayyana tarin maki da suke ba da faɗi iri ɗaya.
z-m-34-10.material: Akwai maki biyu A(0, 0), B(6, 0) a kan faifan haɗin gwiwar. Ba a san haɗin gwiwar maki C ba tukuna. Kana son nemo faɗin alwatika ABC, kuma za ka bincika ko bayani guda ɗaya game da maki C ya isa ya kayyade faɗin. (Ka ɗauka cewa maki C ba ya kan layin da ya ratsa sashen AB, domin a sami alwatika.)

z-m-34-10.prereq.1: Tushen alwatika da tsayinsa a kan faifan haɗin gwiwar
z-m-34-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk bayanan da ke ƙasa waɗanda su kaɗai suke kayyade faɗin alwatika ABC.
z-m-34-10.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane bayani, nuna maki C guda biyu da za su yiwu, sannan ka kwatanta ko tsayin alwatikan ya yi daidai.
z-m-34-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda ake karanta tsayi idan tushen AB yana kan x-axis.
z-m-34-10.s.s1.o.a: Maki C yana kan layi y = x
z-m-34-10.s.s1.r.a: Tsayin ya danganta da wurin da maki C yake a kan y = x. Kwatanta faɗin da aka samu a (1, 1) da kuma (5, 5).
z-m-34-10.s.s1.o.b: Maki C yana kan layi y = 4
z-m-34-10.s.s1.o.c: Ƙididdigar x ta maki C ita ce 2
z-m-34-10.s.s1.r.c: Ƙididdigar x kaɗai ba ta nuna maka tsayin daga tushen ba, saboda haka ba a kayyade faɗin ba. Kwatanta (2, 1) da (2, 5).
z-m-34-10.s.s1.o.d: Maki C yana kan da'irar x² + y² = 25
z-m-34-10.s.s1.r.d: Makin da ke kan da'ira suna da tsayi daban-daban. Kwatanta tsayin kusa da (5, 0) da wanda yake a (0, 5).
z-m-34-10.s.s1.o.e: Ƙididdigar y ta maki C ita ce −3
z-m-34-10.s.s1.explain: Tushen AB (tsawonsa 6) da tsayin ne suke kayyade faɗin, kuma tsayin shi ne absolute value na ƙididdigar y ta C. Bayanin da ke nuna ƙididdigar y (ƙimarta ta absolute) kaɗai ya isa. Idan y = 4, tsayin 4 ne, saboda haka faɗin 12 ne; idan ƙididdigar y −3 ce, tsayin 3 ne, faɗin kuma 9 ne. Ga sauran bayanan, tsayi daban-daban da dama na iya yiwuwa.
z-m-34-10.s.s2.prompt: Nemo sannan ka shigar da maki C(x, y) guda 3 daban-daban inda faɗin alwatika ABC yake 12. (Haɗin gwiwar lambobi cikakku ne.)
z-m-34-10.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo tsayin da ake buƙata idan tushen 6 ne, domin faɗin ya zama 12.
z-m-34-10.s.s2.hint.1: Gwada da misali guda ko ƙididdigar x za ta iya bambanta muddin tsayin ya dace.
z-m-34-10.s.s2.fail.c1: Da fatan za a shigar da x da y a matsayin lambobi cikakku.
z-m-34-10.s.s2.ok.c2: Faɗin alwatika ABC 12 ne. (Tushen 6 ne, tsayin kuma absolute value na y ne.)
z-m-34-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Faɗin alwatika ABC ba 12 ba ne. Nemo faɗin daga tsawon tushen AB da tsayin C.

z-m-34-03.title: Idan coefficients na x squared da y squared sun yi daidai, shin kullum da'ira ce?
z-m-34-03.topic: Equations na siffofi: sharadin da zai sa sifar gaba ɗaya ta equation na da'ira ta zama da'ira
z-m-34-03.goal: Nuna ta misali mai karya ƙa'ida da sake rubuta jimla cewa x² + y² + (jimlar daraja ta farko) = 0 na iya zama da'ira ko a'a gwargwadon ƙimar harafi k; sannan fassara ma'anar iyaka (maki guda ɗaya).
z-m-34-03.material: Akwai equation x² + y² + 4x − 2ky + 10 = 0 (k lamba ce ta gaske). Hyeonu ya ce, "Coefficients na x squared da y squared sun yi daidai, saboda haka ko wace ce k, wannan equation tana wakiltar da'ira."
z-m-34-03.prereq.1: Ma'anar equation na da'ira (x − a)² + (y − b)² = r²
z-m-34-03.prereq.2: Dalilin da ya sa r² dole ya zama tabbatacce a equation na da'ira
z-m-34-03.s.s1.prompt: Yaya za a yanke hukunci kan maganar Hyeonu?
z-m-34-03.s.s1.hint.0: Saka ƙimomi kamar 0 da 3 ga k ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan tsara irin sifar da equation ke samu.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.hint.1: Raba kalmomin da ke ɗauke da x da waɗanda ke ɗauke da y, duba ko siffofi kamar (x + wani adadi)² da (y − wani adadi)² sun bayyana.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.o.a: Kullum da'ira ce ko wace ce k: saboda coefficients na x squared da y squared sun yi daidai
z-m-34-03.s.s1.r.a: Daidaitattun coefficients na nufin zai iya kasancewa da siffar da'ira. Dole ne a duba dabam ko square na radius tabbatacce ne.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.o.b: Ya danganta da ƙimar k, tana iya zama da'ira ko a'a
z-m-34-03.s.s1.r.b: Ba ka gaskata da 'koyaushe' kawai ba, ka bar yiwuwar cewa ya danganta da wani sharadi. Mu gwada wannan hukunci ta saka ƙimomin k.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.o.c: Sai idan k = 0 ba da'ira ba ce, ga sauran ƙimomi duka da'ira ce
z-m-34-03.s.s1.r.c: Ka ga k = 0 a matsayin keɓantacce kawai. Saka wasu ƙimomi don duba ko wasu k ma ba sa samar da da'ira.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.o.d: Babu k da ke samar da da'ira: constant term 10 ya yi yawa
z-m-34-03.s.s1.r.d: Za ka iya gwada wannan magana ta saka ƙima babba kamar k = 3.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.explain: Ba za ka ce da'ira ce saboda coefficients sun yi daidai kawai ba. Dole ne ka mayar da ita zuwa squares, sannan ka tabbatar ƙimar gefen dama tabbatacciya ce.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri misalin karya da zai nuna da'awar Hyeonu ba daidai ba ce. Nemo ka shigar da integers k guda 3 daban-daban waɗanda ba su samar da da'ira ba.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sanya k = 0, 1, 2, 3, ... a jere, ƙirƙiri tebur da ke nuna yadda ƙimar gefen dama ke canzawa idan ka haɗa kalmomin x da y.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.hint.1: Raba yanayin da ƙimar gefen dama ta fi 0 da wanda ba haka ba.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Shigar da k a matsayin integer.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Idan aka sake rubuta equation a sigar square, ƙimar gefen dama 0 ce ko ƙasa da haka; saboda haka ba da'ira ba ce.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ga wannan k, ƙimar gefen dama (k squared minus 6) tabbatacciya ce, don haka da'ira ce. Nemo ƙimomin da ba sa samar da da'ira.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.explain: Ana iya sake rubuta ta (x + 2)² + (y − k)² = k² − 6, saboda haka ba da'ira ba ce idan k² ≤ 6. Integers k da suka dace su ne −2, −1, 0, 1, 2. Idan k = 3 ko −4 da'ira ce.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta kewayon k da ba ya samar da da'ira da yadda ka nemo kewayon.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Zaɓi ɗaya daga k da ka shigar ka sake rubuta equation da kanka a sigar square.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nemo k ɗin da ke sa ƙimar gefen dama ta zama 0.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Na bayyana sharadin ƙimar gefen dama ta zama tabbatacciya ta amfani da expression da na rubuta?
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Na yi tunanin abin da ke faruwa a ƙarshen (iyaka) kewayon?
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan aka haɗa x da y aka rubuta (x + 2)² + (y − k)² = k² − 6, square na radius shi ne k² − 6. Idan wannan ƙima 0 ce ko ƙasa da haka ba da'ira ba ce; saboda haka idan absolute value na k bai wuce √6 ba, ba da'ira ba ce.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan aka mayar da ita sifar square, gefen dama ya zama k squared minus 6. Idan wannan ƙima ba ta fi 0 ba, radius ba zai kasance ba, don haka kowace integer daga −2 zuwa 2 ba ta samar da da'ira ba.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.prompt: Idan k = √6 (tushen 6), wace siffa equation x² + y² + 4x − 2ky + 10 = 0 ke wakilta?
z-m-34-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo k ɗin da zai sa ƙimar gefen dama ta zama 0, sannan ka saka shi cikin ma'aunin.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa murabba'i ba zai gaza 0 ba, sannan ka nemo maki da suka cika ma'aunin.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.o.a: Yana wakiltar maki guda ɗaya kawai (−2, √6)
z-m-34-03.s.s3.o.b: Da'ira ce mai tsakiya (−2, √6) da radius √6
z-m-34-03.s.s3.r.b: Lissafa radius ɗin da za a samu idan ƙimar gefen dama, k murabba'i an rage 6, ta zama 0.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.o.c: Babu maki ko ɗaya da ya cika wannan ma'aunin
z-m-34-03.s.s3.r.c: Ka nemo da kanka maki da ya cika (x + 2)² + (y − k)² = 0.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.o.d: Ƙaramar da'ira ce mai radius kusan 0
z-m-34-03.s.s3.r.d: Ba 'kusan' ba ne; daidai 0 ne. Ka yi tunanin maki nawa ne suka rage idan ya zama daidai 0.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.explain: Idan k = √6, ana samun (x + 2)² + (y − √6)² = 0. Domin jimillar murabba'ai ta zama 0, dole murabba'in biyun su zama 0, saboda haka maki guda ne kawai, inda x = −2, y = √6.

z-m-34-08.title: Shin layin da aka samu daga daidaiton da’irori biyu koyaushe yana ratsa wuraren da suke haɗuwa?
z-m-34-08.topic: Daidaiton siffofi: layin da aka samu daga daidaiton da’irori biyu (matsayin da’irori biyu)
z-m-34-08.goal: Gwada da misalai domin gano sharuddan da za a iya amfani da ƙa’idar cewa layin da aka samu ta hanyar rage daidaiton da’irori biyu yana ratsa wuraren haɗuwarsu, sannan ka faɗi sharuddan amfani da ƙa’idar da kanka.
z-m-34-08.material: Akwai da’ira C₁: x² + y² = 4 (cibiya (0, 0), radius 2). Seoa ta koyi ƙa’idar nan: “Layin da aka samu ta hanyar rage daidaiton da’irori biyu daga juna layi ne da ke ratsa maki na gama-gari na da’irorin.” Za ka bincika ko za a iya amfani da wannan ƙa’ida a kowane yanayi, kana sauya sabuwar da’ira ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
z-m-34-08.thinking.0: Binciken sharuddan da ƙa’idar take aiki a ƙarƙashinsu

z-m-34-08.prereq.2: Ma’anar maki da ya cika daidaito biyu a lokaci guda
z-m-34-08.s.s1.prompt: Za a bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ka zaɓi hukuncinka a kowane mataki.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, ka kwatanta tazarar da ke tsakanin cibiyoyin da’irori biyu da jimillar radiyus ɗinsu.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi maki a kan layin, sannan ka saka shi kai tsaye cikin daidaiton da’irorin biyu.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Ka kawo da’ira C₂: (x − 2)² + y² = 4 (cibiya (2, 0), radius 2). Rage daidaiton C₁ da C₂ daga juna, sannan bayan sauƙaƙawa aka samu layin x = 1.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Shin layin x = 1 yana ratsa wuraren da da’irorin biyu suka haɗu?
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.after: (1, √3) da (1, −√3) maki ne da suka cika daidaiton da’irorin biyu, kuma dukkansu suna kan x = 1. A wannan yanayin ƙa’idar ta yi aiki yadda ya kamata.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Babu dangantaka: rage daidaito lissafi ne kawai, kuma ba shi da alaƙa da siffofin zane.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Makin haɗuwa maki ne da ya cika daidaiton biyun. A wannan maki, daidaiton da aka samu bayan ragewa ma yana zama 0. Lissafin yana da ma’ana game da siffofin zane.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Yana ratsasu: maki haɗuwa na da’irorin biyu yana cika daidaiton biyun, saboda haka yana cika daidaiton da aka samu bayan ragewa ma.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka ba da dalilin cewa idan akwai maki haɗuwa, suna kan daidaiton da aka samu bayan ragewa. Bari mu gwada bayanai na gaba don ganin inda wannan dalili yake aiki.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Da’irorin biyu ba sa haɗuwa: domin idan an samu daidaiton layi, to wannan ba da’ira ba ce.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Sakamakon rage daidaiton da’ira ya zama layi, da kuma ko da’irorin biyu sun haɗu, abubuwa ne dabam. Saka (1, √3) cikin kowane daidaito.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Yana ratsasu: saka (1, √3) cikin daidaiton da’irorin biyu yana sa dukkansu su cika, kuma wannan maki yana kan x = 1.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ka bincika ta hanyar maye gurbin kai tsaye. Ka bincika maki ɗaya, don haka ba ka tabbatar da ƙa’idar gaba ɗaya ba, amma shaidar ta wadatar ga wannan yanayin.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.info: A wannan karon ka kawo da’ira C₃: (x − 6)² + y² = 4 (cibiya (6, 0), radius 2). Rage daidaiton C₁ da C₃ daga juna, sannan bayan sauƙaƙawa aka samu layin x = 3.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Shin layin x = 3 yana ratsa maki na gama-gari na da’irorin biyu?
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.after: C₁ tana da maki ne kawai inda x yake tsakanin −2 da 2, saboda haka babu maki na C₁ a kan x = 3. Ƙa’idar tana cewa kawai “idan akwai maki haɗuwa, suna kan daidaiton da aka samu bayan ragewa”; ba ta ce akwai maki haɗuwa saboda kawai an samu daidaiton layi ba. Dole ne a gyara hukuncin farko ta ƙara sharadi.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Akwai maki na gama-gari a x = 3: hanyar iri ɗaya ce da ta baya, saboda haka sakamakon iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ko da hanyar iri ɗaya ce, matsayin da’irar ya canza. Bincika iyakar ƙimar maƙasudin x na C₁.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Babu maki na gama-gari a x = 3: C₁ tana da maki ne kawai idan x bai wuce 2 ba.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka bincika iyakar ƙimar kai tsaye daga cibiyar da radius na da’irar. Ko da an samu layi daga daidaiton, dole ne ka bincika dabam ko akwai maki na gama-gari.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: x = 3 yana kusa da cibiyar C₃, saboda haka yana haɗuwa da C₃ kaɗai.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Maƙasudin x na C₃ yana daga 4 zuwa 8. Bincika ko layin x = 3 yana haɗuwa da C₃.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ko da an samu layi, dole ne a bincika dabam ko akwai maki na gama-gari, saboda haka kada ka yanke hukunci tukuna.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne mai taka-tsantsan. Amma idan ka duba iyakar ƙimar da’irorin, za ka iya yanke hukunci nan take.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.info: A ƙarshe ka kawo da’ira C₄: (x − 4)² + y² = 4 (cibiya (4, 0), radius 2). Rage daidaiton C₁ da C₄ daga juna, sannan bayan sauƙaƙawa aka samu layin x = 2.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Menene dangantakar layin x = 2 da da’irorin C₁ da C₄?
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.after: (2, 0) shi ne maki guda ɗaya tilo na gama-gari da ya cika daidaiton C₁ da C₄, kuma yana kan x = 2. A wannan yanayin x = 2 shi ne layin da ya taɓa da’irorin biyu. Ƙa’idar tana aiki ko da maki guda ɗaya ne kawai na haɗuwa.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Akwai maki haɗuwa biyu na da’irorin a kan x = 2.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Saka x = 2 cikin daidaiton C₁, sannan ka lissafta y.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Da’irorin biyu suna haɗuwa a maki guda (2, 0), kuma layin x = 2 yana ratsa wannan maki.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ko da maki guda ɗaya ne na haɗuwa (yanayin taɓawa), daidaiton da aka samu bayan ragewa yana ratsa wannan maki. Za ka iya bincika ta hanyar maye gurbin kai tsaye.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Da’irorin biyu ba sa haɗuwa, saboda haka x = 2 ba shi da ma’ana.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Bincika ko (2, 0) yana cika daidaiton da’irorin biyu.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: x = 2 yana haɗuwa da C₁ kaɗai, ba ya haɗuwa da C₄.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.reflect: Shin ƙa’idar farko ta yi daidai a wasu yanayi, kuma an ƙara sharudda a wasu? Ta yaya “idan akwai maki haɗuwa, suna kan layin” ya bambanta da “idan an samu layi, to akwai maki haɗuwa”?
z-m-34-08.s.s2.prompt: Ka samu layi ta hanyar rage daidaiton da’irori biyu daga juna. Kafin ka ce layin yana ratsa maki na gama-gari na da’irorin, rubuta abin da dole ne ka fara bincika, sannan ka ba da misali guda inda sakamakon ya bambanta.

z-m-34-08.s.s2.model.0: Dole ne ka kwatanta tazarar da ke tsakanin cibiyoyin da’irorin biyu da radiyus ɗinsu, sannan ka fara bincika ko da’irorin sun haɗu da gaske. Idan suna nesa da juna, kamar da’irori masu radius 2 da cibiyoyi a 0 da 6, to ko da daidaiton da aka rage ya ba da layin x = 3, babu maki na gama-gari.

z-m-34-09.title: Idan ka canza ƙolin alwatika mai kusurwar dama, shin cibiyar da’irori mai kewaye za ta kasance iri ɗaya?

z-m-34-09.goal: Gwada hasashen cewa cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye ba ta canzawa idan an riƙe gefe ɗaya kuma ƙolin kusurwar dama ya motsa, ta amfani da misalan maki masu maƙasudai cikakku; sannan ka bambanta abin da yake canzawa idan kusurwar ba ta zama kusurwar dama ba.

z-m-34-09.s.s1.prompt: Me ke faruwa da cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye idan ka canza C alhali ∠C = 90°? Ka zaɓi bisa ga abin da kake tunani yanzu.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kafa maki C guda ɗaya inda ∠C = 90°, sannan ka zana da hannu inda kake tsammanin cibiyar da’irar take.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kafa wani maki C guda ɗaya, sannan ka kwatanta ko cibiyar da’irar tana wuri ɗaya.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.o.a: Cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye ba ta canzawa ko da ina C yake: koyaushe maki ɗaya ce.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.o.b: Cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye tana canzawa da matsayin C: domin ƙolin ya canza.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.r.b: Kamar Ian, ka yi tunanin cewa idan ƙolin ya canza, cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye ma za ta canza. Bincika da misalai na gaske ko cibiyar tana motsawa.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.o.c: Cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye koyaushe maki ɗaya ce da ƙolin kusurwar dama C.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.r.c: Idan tazarar daga cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye zuwa C ta zama 0, to tazarar zuwa A da B ma dole ta zama 0. Ka yi tunani ko hakan zai yiwu.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.o.d: A cikin alwatika mai kusurwar dama, cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye koyaushe tana wajen alwatikan.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.r.d: Ka yanke hukunci ne daga siffar kawai, ba tare da gano matsayin cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye ba. Nemo matsayin a cikin misali guda.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.explain: Za a gwada wannan hukunci a mataki na gaba ta hanyar ƙirƙirar maki C masu maƙasudai cikakku da kanka. Ko ta yaya, yana da muhimmanci a bincika da misalai.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri maki C(p, q) masu maƙasudai cikakku guda 3 dabam-dabam waɗanda suka cika ∠C = 90°. (q > 0, p da q lambobi ne cikakku.)
z-m-34-09.s.s2.hint.0: Domin C ta zama kusurwar dama, ka yi tunani game da dangantakar da ya kamata alkiblar daga C zuwa A da alkiblar daga C zuwa B su kasance da ita.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.hint.1: Canza p daga 1 zuwa 9, sannan ka yi jadawali don bincika ko q lamba ce cikakkiya.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.hint.2: Auna tazarar daga maki da ka samo zuwa (5, 0), sannan ka kwatanta su.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.ok.c1: C yana sama da axis x.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.ok.c3: Alkiblar daga C zuwa A da kuma daga C zuwa B suna tsaye da juna, saboda haka ∠C kusurwar dama ce.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.fail.c3: ∠C ba kusurwar dama ba ce. Haɗa ninkar sassan kwance da ninkar sassan tsaye na sauyin daga C zuwa A da daga C zuwa B, sannan ka bincika ko jimillarsu 0 ce.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.explain: Maki C masu maƙasudai cikakku da suka cika sharadin su ne (1, 3), (2, 4), (5, 5), (8, 4), (9, 3). Dukkan waɗannan maki suna da tazara 5 daga (5, 0). Wato, maki ne a kan da’irar da AB yake diamitarta.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta inda cibiyar da’irar take ga maki C da ka samo, da kuma dalilin da ya sa take kasancewa a wuri ɗaya.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ga ɗaya daga cikin maki C da ka samo, nemi maki mai tazara iri ɗaya daga A, B da kuma wannan C.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka yi tunani game da siffar da maki da ka samo suka samar (ko suna kan da’ira ɗaya).
z-m-34-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Za a iya bincika maƙasudan cibiyar da’irar da na rubuta ta amfani da aƙalla ɗaya daga cikin maki C da na samo?
z-m-34-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Na bayyana “dalilin da ya sa wurin yake iri ɗaya” ta amfani da tazara ko da’ira?
z-m-34-09.s.s2.because.model.0: Maki (1, 3), (5, 5), (9, 3) da na samo duk suna da tazara 5 daga (5, 0), saboda haka maki mai tazara iri ɗaya daga ƙololuwa A, B, C guda uku shi ne (5, 0). Wato, tsakiyar AB ita ce cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan C kusurwar dama ce, C yana kan da’irar da AB yake diamitarta, saboda haka tazarar daga cibiyar (5, 0) zuwa A, B, da C duk sun yi daidai da radius 5. Saboda haka cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye ita ce tsakiyar hypotenuse AB.
z-m-34-09.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon, alwatika ABC tana da ƙoli C(5, 6), inda ∠C ba kusurwar dama ba ce. Ina cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye take?
z-m-34-09.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo layin da maki masu tazara iri ɗaya daga A da B suke a kai.
z-m-34-09.s.s3.hint.1: Ga maki (5, y) a kan wannan layi, nemo y domin tazararsa zuwa A da tazararsa zuwa C su yi daidai.
z-m-34-09.s.s3.o.a: Har yanzu (5, 0) ce: cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye ta kasance tsakiyar gefen AB.
z-m-34-09.s.s3.r.a: Ka kwatanta tazarar daga (5, 0) zuwa C(5, 6) da tazararsa zuwa A.
z-m-34-09.s.s3.o.b: Ba ya kan layin x = 5: domin C ya canza.
z-m-34-09.s.s3.r.b: Cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye maki ne mai tazara iri ɗaya daga A da B. Ka yi tunani game da layin da irin waɗannan maki suke a kai.
z-m-34-09.s.s3.o.c: Yana kan layin x = 5, amma ba (5, 0) ba ne.
z-m-34-09.s.s3.o.d: Babu cibiyar da’irar da ke kewaye: idan kusurwar ba kusurwar dama ba ce, babu da’ira da ke ratsa ƙololuwa ukun.
z-m-34-09.s.s3.r.d: Alwatika da ba ta da kusurwar dama ma tana da da’ira da ke kewaye da ita. Kusurwar dama tana canza matsayin cibiyar da’irar kawai.
z-m-34-09.s.s3.explain: Maki masu tazara iri ɗaya daga A da B suna kan layin x = 5. Daga cikinsu, maki mai tazara iri ɗaya daga C(5, 6) ma shi ne (5, 11/12). Daga (5, 0), tazarar zuwa C ita ce 6, ta zuwa A kuma 5, saboda haka wannan ba ita ce cibiyar da’irar ba. Cibiyar da’irar ta kasance a wuri ɗaya ne saboda sharadin ∠C = 90°.

z-m-34-01.title: Idan an ba da maki uku, shin akwai madaidaicin wuri ɗaya kaɗai na kusurwa ta huɗu?
z-m-34-01.topic: Equations na siffofi: kusurwa ta huɗu ta parallelogram (coordinates na maki)
z-m-34-01.goal: Nemo da kanka, sannan tabbatar da coordinates, cewa kusurwa ta huɗu ta parallelogram da aka bayar da maki uku na iya kasancewa a wurare da dama; yanke hukunci kan yadda sharadin wuraren maki ukun (ko suna kan layi ɗaya) ke sauya sakamakon.
z-m-34-01.material: A kan farantin coordinates akwai maki A(0, 0), B(4, 1), C(1, 3). Kana son yin parallelogram mai waɗannan maki uku da maki D a matsayin kusurwoyi huɗu. An ba sunayen kusurwoyin ba tare da kayyade tsarin haɗawarsu ba, kuma dole siffar ta zama quadrilateral na gaske, maki huɗun ba su kan layi ɗaya ba. Jiho ya ce, "D ita ce (5, 4) kaɗai."
z-m-34-01.thinking.0: Gwada sharadin da da'awar 'guda ɗaya ce' ke aiki a ƙarƙashinsa
z-m-34-01.thinking.1: Ƙayyade ma'aunin rarraba yanayi da nemo su duka ba tare da barin ko ɗaya ba
z-m-34-01.thinking.2: Yanke hukunci ko sakamakon zai canza idan sharadin ya canza
z-m-34-01.prereq.0: Zato: 'H3' na wannan aiki lakabin wahala ne kawai daga matakin samarwa, ba sanya shi a wani ajin manhaja ba. Ana ɗauka ɗalibi ya koyi lissafin makarantar sakandare ta ƙasa da farkon Common Mathematics na sakandare 'equations of figures' (farantin coordinates, equations na layuka da da'irori).
z-m-34-01.prereq.1: Yana iya sanya maki a farantin coordinates da karanta canjin coordinates tsakanin maki biyu (nawa aka matsa gefe da sama ko ƙasa)
z-m-34-01.prereq.2: Ya san ma'anar parallelogram (nau'i biyu na gefuna masu fuskantar juna suna layi ɗaya)
z-m-34-01.s.s1.prompt: Shin D ɗaya ce kawai da gaske, kamar yadda Jiho ya ce? Da farko hasashen adadin wuraren da D za ta iya kasancewa.
z-m-34-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sanya A, B, da C a farantin coordinates, da farko zana parallelogram ɗaya mai waɗannan maki a matsayin kusurwoyi.
z-m-34-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo yanayin da D yake wani wuri daban da na farko da ka zana amma maki huɗun har yanzu suna samar da parallelogram.
z-m-34-01.s.s1.o.a: Wuri 1: wuraren A, B, C sun riga sun kayyadu, don haka sauran maki D ma ya kayyadu zuwa guda ɗaya
z-m-34-01.s.s1.r.a: Ka riga ka kayyade maki masu fuskantar juna daga sunayen A, B, C kawai. Ka sake karanta cewa ba a bayar da tsarin sunayen maki ba.
z-m-34-01.s.s1.o.b: Wurare 2: ɗaya sama da gefen AB, ɗaya kuma ƙasa da shi
z-m-34-01.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi tunanin sama da ƙasa na gefe ɗaya kawai. Wanne daga maki biyu ne ke fuskantar juna a parallelogram zai iya canzawa ta hanyoyi uku.
z-m-34-01.s.s1.o.c: Wurare 3: ya danganta da wanne daga A, B, C ka sanya ya fuskanci D
z-m-34-01.s.s1.r.c: Ka ƙayyade ma'aunin raba yanayi da kanka (maki da ke fuskantar D). Dole ne a tabbatar da wannan da coordinates na gaske.
z-m-34-01.s.s1.o.d: Mara iyaka: duk inda ka sanya maki na huɗu a farantin, ana iya yin parallelogram
z-m-34-01.s.s1.r.d: Sharadin cewa gefuna masu fuskantar juna su yi layi ɗaya yana takaita wurin D sosai. Ba zai iya kasancewa ko'ina ba.
z-m-34-01.s.s1.explain: D tana zuwa wani wuri daban gwargwadon ko maki da ke fuskantar D shi ne A, B, ko C. Ko da gaske wurare uku ne za a tabbatar da coordinates a mataki na gaba.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri coordinates 3 daban-daban na D domin maki A, B, C, D (a kowane tsari) su zama kusurwoyi huɗu na parallelogram.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.hint.0: A cikin parallelogram ɗin da ka riga ka zana, rubuta nawa x da y suke canzawa daga A zuwa B, sannan kwatanta ko haka yake a gefen da yake fuskantar sa.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi ɗaya daga A, B, C a matsayin maki da ke fuskantar D, sannan matsar da canjin tsakanin sauran maki biyun zuwa hanyar D zuwa maki ɗin.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.hint.2: Bayan ka nemo ɗaya, sauya maki mai fuskantar juna ka maimaita hanyar.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Matsakaitan sassan layin da suka haɗa maki masu fuskantar juna suna wuri ɗaya. Wannan parallelogram ne.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Wannan D ba ta samar da parallelogram. Zaɓi maki ɗaya a matsayin wanda ke fuskantar D, ka duba ko canjin kwance da na tsaye tsakanin sauran maki biyun ya yi daidai da na tsakanin D da wannan maki.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.explain: D tana wurare uku (5, 4), (−3, 2), (3, −2). Waɗannan yanayin D na fuskantar C, B, da A bi da bi ne. Misali, ga (5, 4), canjin kwance da tsaye (4, 1) daga A zuwa B iri ɗaya ne da canjin daga C zuwa D.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta da kalmominka dalilin da ya sa za ka iya cewa D tana da waɗannan wurare uku kawai.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Haɗa maki ukun da ka samu, sannan ka duba ko gefunan da ke fuskantar juna suna layi ɗaya.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ƙirga nawa daga A, B, C za a iya zaɓa a matsayin maki mai fuskantar juna.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: A cikin bayanina, ma'aunin raba yanayi ya bayyana sarai?
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Na ci gaba da rubuta dalilin 'babu wasu'?
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan A ce maki da ke fuskantar D, D ita ce (5, 4); idan B ce, (−3, 2); idan C ce, (3, −2). A, B, C ne kaɗai za su iya fuskantar juna, saboda haka waɗannan ukun su ne duka.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Akwai hanyoyi 3 na zaɓar ɗaya daga maki ukun a matsayin wanda ke fuskantar D; da zarar an kayyade maki mai fuskantar, D ma tana kayyaduwa zuwa guda ɗaya. Saboda haka D tana da wurare 3 aƙalla.
z-m-34-01.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon maki ukun suna kan layi ɗaya, kamar A(0, 0), B(2, 2), C(4, 4). Me zai faru da parallelogram mai waɗannan maki huɗu a matsayin kusurwoyi?
z-m-34-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sanya A, B, C a kan farantin coordinates ka tabbatar ko suna kan layi ɗaya.
z-m-34-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo D guda ɗaya da hanyar baya, sannan sanya wuraren maki huɗun a hoto.
z-m-34-01.s.s3.o.a: Ba za a iya samar da shi ba: maki huɗun suna kwance a kan layi ɗaya
z-m-34-01.s.s3.o.b: Har yanzu ana iya samar da shi a wurare 3: yi amfani da hanyar baya kamar yadda take
z-m-34-01.s.s3.r.b: Idan ka yi amfani da hanyar yadda take, za ka sami maki, amma ba ka duba ko maki huɗun duka suna kan layi ɗaya ba.
z-m-34-01.s.s3.o.c: Ana samar da shi a wuri 1 kawai: maki ukun suna kan layi madaidaiciya, don haka yanayin ya ragu
z-m-34-01.s.s3.r.c: Batun ba raguwar yanayi ba ne, amma ko za a iya samar da quadrilateral kwata-kwata.
z-m-34-01.s.s3.o.d: Ana samar da shi a wurare 2: akwai maki na tsakiya, ɗaya a kowane gefe
z-m-34-01.s.s3.r.d: Zana wuraren maki da aka samar daga maki da ke kan layi madaidaiciya.
z-m-34-01.s.s3.explain: Idan maki ukun suna kan layi ɗaya, D ɗin da ka samu ta daidaita matsakaitan ma tana kan wannan layin. Idan maki huɗun duka suna kan layi, siffar ba ta da fili, saboda haka ba parallelogram ba ce. Wannan misali ne na sabon sharadi da ke canza sakamako.

z-m-34-02.title: Layin tangent da aka zana daga P(3, 5) zuwa da'ira: za mu yarda da mafitar?
z-m-34-02.topic: Equations na siffofi: layukan tangent daga maki wajen da'ira (siffar equation na layi)
z-m-34-02.goal: Da farko yanke hukuncin yawan tangent daga maki zuwa da'ira, sannan nemo ka gyara yanayin da ya ɓace (layi marar gangarawa) a mafitar da ta samo guda ɗaya kawai.
z-m-34-02.material: Akwai da'ira x² + y² = 9 (cibiya a asali, radius 3) da maki P(3, 5). Jiho ya yi ƙoƙarin nemo layukan tangent daga P zuwa da'irar, ya warware kamar haka. Lambobin layukan mafitar suna farawa daga 1.
z-m-34-02.thinking.0: Duba zato da ke bayan mafitar
z-m-34-02.thinking.1: Nemo dalili idan sakamakon ya bambanta da hasashenka
z-m-34-02.thinking.2: Nemo yanayin da ya ɓace da kanka ka tabbatar da shi
z-m-34-02.prereq.1: Ma'anar tazara tsakanin maki da layi
z-m-34-02.prereq.2: Ma'anar equation na da'ira x squared plus y squared = r squared
z-m-34-02.prereq.3: Bambancin layukan da ke da gangarawa da waɗanda ba su da gangarawa (layuka masu layi ɗaya da y-axis)
z-m-34-02.s.s1.prompt: Kafin ka kalli mafitar, layukan tangent nawa za a iya zana daga P(3, 5) zuwa wannan da'ira?
z-m-34-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta tazara daga cibiyar da'ira zuwa P da radius, sannan yanke hukuncin wurin P.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.hint.1: Zana yanayin da P yake kan da'ira, ciki, da waje; ƙirga yawan tangent da za a iya zana.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.o.a: 1: ana iya zana tangent guda ɗaya daga kowane maki
z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.a: Idan maki yana kan da'ira, tangent ɗaya ne. Duba ko P yana kan da'ira, cikinta, ko wajenta.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.o.b: Ba a sani ba: sai an san tazara tsakanin maki da da'ira, kuma ba ka san ta yanzu ba
z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.b: Ana iya samun tazara daga asali zuwa P daga coordinates kaɗai. Bai yi wuri a ce bayanin bai isa ba.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.o.c: 2: P yana wajen da'ira, saboda haka ana iya zana ɗaya a kowane gefe
z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.c: Ka hasashen adadin tangent daga wurin maki. Wannan zai zama mizani don kwatanta da sakamakon mafita.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.o.d: Mara iyaka: wasu daga layukan da aka zana daga P zuwa da'ira kullum tangent ne
z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.d: Layin tangent layi ne da ke taɓa da'ira a maki ɗaya kawai. Yi tunani da hoto don sanin adadinsu.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.explain: Tazara daga asali zuwa P ita ce √34 (kimanin 5.8), fiye da radius 3; saboda haka P yana wajen da'ira. Ana iya zana tangent 2 daga maki wajen da'ira.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya a mafitar Jiho mai matsala. (Wataƙila akwai layukan matsala fiye da ɗaya.)
z-m-34-02.s.s2.hint.0: Duba ko kowane layi ya biyo daidai daga layin gabansa; ga layukan da ba lissafi ba ne, ka yi la'akari ko zato ko ƙarshe da suka faɗa kullum gaskiya ne.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi la'akari ko equation na layin da mafitar ta yi amfani da shi zai iya wakiltar duk layukan da suka ratsa P.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.0: Idan gangarawar tangent m ce, tangent ɗin ita ce y − 5 = m(x − 3).
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.1: Dole tazara daga cibiyar da'ira (0, 0) zuwa wannan layi ta yi daidai da radius 3, don haka |5 − 3m| / √(m² + 1) = 3.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.2: Ninka bangarorin biyu da kansu sannan sauƙaƙa, a samu 25 − 30m + 9m² = 9m² + 9, don haka m = 8/15.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.3: Saboda haka tangent ɗaya kaɗai ce y − 5 = (8/15)(x − 3).
z-m-34-02.s.s2.explain: Layi na 1 ya ɗauka cewa tangent tana da gangarawa, kuma layi na 4 shi ne ƙarshe 'guda ɗaya kawai' da ya biyo daga wannan zato. Lissafi (layuka 2 da 3) daidai ne. Layi marar gangarawa (mai layi ɗaya da y-axis) ba za a iya rubuta shi a sigar y − 5 = m(x − 3) ba, saboda haka mafitar ta bar shi.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta dalilin da ya sa tangent ɗaya kawai ta fito da equation na tangent ɗin da ya ɓace; sannan rubuta hanya ɗaya ta tabbatar da cewa layin tangent ne da gaske.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin layin da equation na Jiho ba zai iya wakilta ga kowace ƙimar m ba.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.hint.1: Auna tazara kai tsaye daga asali zuwa wannan layi.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Na nemo kuma na rubuta equation na layin da ya ɓace da kaina?
z-m-34-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Na tabbatar da gaske cewa tangent ne ta hanyar da na rubuta?
z-m-34-02.s.s3.model.0: Idan aka sa gangarawa m, ba za a iya bayyana layin tsaye ba, saboda haka ya ɓace. Sauran shi ne x = 3, tazara daga asali zuwa layin kuma 3 ce, daidai da radius, don haka tangent ne.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.model.1: Layin x = 3, mai layi ɗaya da y-axis, ba shi da gangarawa, saboda haka bai fito a equation ba. Idan aka haɗa x = 3 da da'ira x² + y² = 9, suna haɗuwa a maki (3, 0) guda ɗaya kawai, don haka tangent ne.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.model.2: Equation mai gangarawa m ba zai iya wakiltar layin da yake tsaye da x-axis ba, saboda haka an rasa tangent ɗaya. Wanda ya ɓace shi ne x=3, kuma tazararsa daga asali 3 ce, don haka tangent ne.

z-m-34-04.title: Idan jimillar murabba'in nisoshi zuwa maki biyu ta kasance tsayayye, wace siffa ce za a samu?
z-m-34-04.topic: Ma'aunan siffofi: yanayin maki da jimillar murabba'in nisoshinsu zuwa maki biyu take tsayayye
z-m-34-04.goal: Yi amfani da ma'auni don gwada hasashen da aka yi daga ƴan maki, sannan ka bayyana, tare da sharuddan, yadda tarin maki ke sauyawa daga da'ira zuwa maki guda, sannan babu maki yayin da ƙimar tsayayye ke canzawa.
z-m-34-04.material: A kan faifan haɗin gwiwar akwai maki biyu A(−2, 0), B(2, 0). Ka yi la'akari da tarin dukkan maki P(x, y) da suka cika PA² + PB² = k. (PA² shi ne murabba'in nisan tsakanin P da A, wato nisan P da A a murabba'i; k kuma ƙima ce tsayayyiya.)
z-m-34-04.thinking.2: Faɗi sharuddan sakamakon idan ƙimar tsayayyiya ta canza
z-m-34-04.s.s1.prompt: Za a bayyana bayanan ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, zaɓi ra'ayinka game da irin siffar da tarin maki yake yi.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, ware abin da ya canza daga matakin baya da abin da bai canza ba.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.hint.1: Don bincika ko sifar da ka zaɓa daidai ce, zaɓi maki guda sannan ka lissafa PA² da PB² da kanka.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Ka saita k = 16 sannan ka gwada ƴan maki. P(2, 0), P(0, 2), P(−2, 0) duk sun cika PA² + PB² = 16.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wace siffa kake tsammani duk maki da suka cika sharadin suke yi?
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Makin ukun suna kan da'ira mai tsakiya a asali da radius 2. Amma maki uku kaɗai ba za su tabbatar da cewa 'da'ira ce' ba, saboda haka ya dace a riƙe wannan a matsayin hasashe.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Nisan maki ukun daga asali duka 2 ne, saboda haka kamar da'ira ce. Ina so in gwada ƙarin maki ma
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan hasashe ne mai kyau da ya bar yiwuwar sauya hukuncinka idan aka sami ƙarin maki.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Layi ne da ya ratsa maki ukun
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kwatanta haɗin gwiwar maki ukun. Za ka iya bincika ko suna kan layi guda.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Makin ukun nan ne kawai. Babu wasu maki
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lissafa ko wani maki, misali (0, −2), ya cika sharadin.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Tabbas da'ira ce, saboda haka babu buƙatar ƙarin bincike
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ba za ka iya tabbatar da cewa da'ira ce daga maki uku kaɗai ba. Akwai siffofi da yawa da za su ratsa dukkan maki ukun.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Idan maki P(x, y) ne, kuma aka rubuta ta amfani da haɗin gwiwa, PA² = (x + 2)² + y², PB² = (x − 2)² + y². Idan aka tara su aka sauƙaƙa, ana samun 2x² + 2y² + 8 = k.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Idan k = 16, wace siffa ce duk maki da suka cika sharadin suke yi?
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan 2x² + 2y² + 8 = 16, to x² + y² = 4. Ma'auni ya tabbatar da hasashen farko (da'ira), kuma radius ɗin 2 ne. Wannan yanayi ne da za ka iya riƙe hasashen yadda yake.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Da'ira mai tsakiya a asali da radius 4
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lissafa ƙimar x² + y², sannan ka bincika ko wannan ƙimar murabba'in radius ce ko radius ɗin kanta.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Da'ira mai tsakiya a asali da radius 2
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ma'auni ya tabbatar da hasashen. Wannan sakamakon ya samo asali ne daga lissafin cewa murabba'in radius 4 ne.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Makin da suke da nisa iri ɗaya daga A da B, wato layin y-axis
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Sharadin ba PA = PB ba ne, sai dai PA² + PB² ya zama tsayayye.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Da'ira mai tsakiya a asali da radius 8
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Idan ka raba 2x² + 2y² + 8 = 16 da 2, ka bincika ko ka raba 8 ɗin ma.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Bayan sauƙaƙawa ana samun x² + y² = (k − 8)/2. Yanzu canza k ka duba yanayin k = 8 da k = 4.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Idan k = 8 da kuma idan k = 4, me ke faruwa ga maki da suka cika sharadin?
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan k = 8, to x² + y² = 0, saboda haka asali ne kawai; idan k = 4, to x² + y² = −2, saboda haka babu maki da ya cika sharadin. Da'ira ce kawai idan k > 8. Hasashen farko ya koma sakamako mai sharadin cewa k yana cikin wani zangon.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yayin da k ke raguwa, da'irar ma tana raguwa: idan k = 8 radius ɗin 2 ne, idan k = 4 radius ɗin 1 ne
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lissafa abin da ake samu idan ka saka k = 8 cikin (k − 8)/2.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Da'ira ce ko wane ne k, kuma idan k = 4 da'ira ce mai radius mara kyau
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Radius nisa ne, saboda haka ba zai zama mara kyau ba. Ka yi tunani ko akwai maki da ya cika x² + y² = (ƙima mara kyau).
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Idan k = 8, asali kaɗai ne, amma idan k = 4, babu irin wannan maki ko kaɗan
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka yanke hukuncin adadin maki ta la'akari da lokacin da x² + y² ya zama 0 ko mara kyau.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Idan k = 8 babu irin wannan maki, amma idan k = 4 asali ne kaɗai
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Bincika ko ƙimar da za ka samu idan ka saka k = 8 da k = 4 cikin (k − 8)/2 ta zama 0 ko mara kyau.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.reflect: Me ya faru da hasashen da ka yi daga maki uku na farko bayan ka gwada shi da ma'auni? Kuma idan k ya canza, wane ɓangare na sakamakon aka sake fasalta ta ƙara sharadi?
z-m-34-04.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta yadda tarin maki P ke sauyawa dangane da ƙimar k. (Haɗa ƙimomin da sauyin ke faruwa.)
z-m-34-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ware yanayin da ƙimar gefen dama a x² + y² = (k − 8)/2 take tabbatacciya, 0, ko marar kyau.
z-m-34-04.s.s2.hint.1: Saka k = 8, k = 20, da k = 0, sannan ka bincika tarin maki da kanka.
z-m-34-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Na rubuta ba tare da barin komai ba irin siffar da ake samu a kowane gefe na ƙimar iyaka kuwa?
z-m-34-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Na bincika yanayin k = 8 dabam kuwa?
z-m-34-04.s.s2.model.0: Idan k ya fi 8, da'ira ce mai tsakiya a asali; idan k = 8, asali kaɗai ne; idan k ya gaza 8, babu maki da ya cika sharadin.
z-m-34-04.s.s2.model.1: Idan k > 8, da'ira ce mai radius √((k − 8)/2); idan k = 8, asali kaɗai ne. Idan k < 8, babu maki ko ɗaya.

z-m-34-06.title: A kan x-axis, akwai maki guda ɗaya kawai da yake da nisa iri ɗaya daga layuka biyu?
z-m-34-06.topic: Ma'aunan siffofi: nemo maki daga sharuddan nisanta daga layuka
z-m-34-06.goal: Nemo kuma ka tabbatar cewa akwai yiwuwar maki biyu a kan x-axis masu nisa iri ɗaya daga layuka biyu, sannan ka yanke hukunci, tare da sharadin, yadda adadin ke canzawa idan layukan biyun suna a layi ɗaya.
z-m-34-06.material: Akwai layi l₁: 3x + 4y − 12 = 0 da layi l₂: 4x + 3y − 9 = 0. Kana son nemo maki P(t, 0) a kan x-axis mai nisoshi iri ɗaya daga layukan biyu. Minseo ya nemo P(3, 0), ya bincika cewa nisoshin duka 3/5 ne, sannan ya ce, "Wannan ne maki guda ɗaya tilo mai nisa iri ɗaya."
z-m-34-06.thinking.0: Yi shakku ko mafitar da ka samo ita ce dukkan mafita
z-m-34-06.thinking.1: Nemo mafita da dama ta hanya mai tsari
z-m-34-06.thinking.2: Yanke hukunci cewa adadin amsoshi yana canzawa bisa sharadi (ko layukan suna a layi ɗaya)
z-m-34-06.s.s1.prompt: Akwai guda ɗaya kawai kamar yadda Minseo ya ce? Yi hasashen maki nawa ne a kan x-axis suke da nisoshi iri ɗaya daga layukan biyu.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.hint.0: Lissafa nisoshin biyun idan t = 3 ka bincika cewa sun yi daidai, sannan ka kwatanta abin da ke faruwa idan ka saka t = 0 da t = 4.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.hint.1: A cikin dabarar nisan maki daga layi, duba abin da ke ƙasa a rabon da kuma alamomin da ƙimar cikin absolute value za ta iya samu.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.o.a: 0: nisoshin zuwa layukan biyu koyaushe sun bambanta a kan x-axis
z-m-34-06.s.s1.r.a: Minseo ya riga ya nemo maki ɗaya P(3, 0) inda nisoshin suka yi daidai. Saboda haka adadin ba 0 ba ne.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.o.b: 1: idan ka daidaita nisoshin ka warware, ƙimar t guda ɗaya ce za ta fito
z-m-34-06.s.s1.r.b: Ka gwada wasu ƙimomin t don bincika ko maki da Minseo ya samo su ne kaɗai da gaske. Dabarar nisa tana da absolute value.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.o.c: Marasa iyaka: maki masu nisoshi iri ɗaya suna ko'ina a kan x-axis
z-m-34-06.s.s1.r.c: Lissafa nisoshin biyun da kanka idan t = 0, sannan ka bincika ko sun yi daidai.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.o.d: 2: kamar za a sami maki ɗaya mai nisoshi iri ɗaya a kowane gefe
z-m-34-06.s.s1.r.d: Ba ka tsaya bayan ka sami maki ɗaya ba, ka kuma yi shakkun ko akwai wasu. Dole ne ka warware ma'aunin da gaske don bincikawa.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.explain: Ka bincika cewa P(3, 0) mafita ɗaya ce, amma sai an warware ma'aunin za a gano ko akwai wasu. Mu nemo su da kanka a mataki na gaba.
z-m-34-06.s.s2.prompt: Daga cikin maki P(t, 0) a kan x-axis, nemo maki 2 daban-daban da nisoshinsu daga layukan l₁ da l₂ suka yi daidai, sannan ka shigar da t.
z-m-34-06.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta dabarun nisa biyun ka duba ko ƙasashensu iri ɗaya ne. Idan haka ne, ka yi tunanin irin alakar da ƙididdigar sama za su kasance da ita.
z-m-34-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunani da misalan lambobi (misali 3 da −3) game da irin alakar da lambobi biyu masu absolute value iri ɗaya za su iya samu.
z-m-34-06.s.s2.var.t: Ƙididdigar x, t, ta maki P
z-m-34-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Nisoshin P(t, 0) daga layukan biyun sun yi daidai. (Ƙasashen rabon layukan duka 5 ne, iri ɗaya.)
z-m-34-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Nisoshin biyun ba su yi daidai ba. Nemo nisan zuwa kowane layi sannan ka kwatanta su.
z-m-34-06.s.s2.explain: Akwai maki biyu, t = 3 da t = −3. Idan t = −3 ne, nisoshin duka 21/5 ne. Dalili kuwa, idan aka cire absolute value, yanayi biyu ne ke fitowa: alamomi iri ɗaya da alamomi masu saɓani. Makin biyun su ne inda layukan da ke raba kusurwar tsakanin layukan biyun (y = x + 3 da x + y = 3) suka haɗu da x-axis.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon layukan biyun sun koma masu layi ɗaya. Idan l₁: 3x + 4y − 12 = 0 da l₃: 3x + 4y + 8 = 0 ne, maki nawa ne a kan x-axis suke da nisa iri ɗaya daga layukan?
z-m-34-06.s.s3.hint.0: Saka t = 2/3 da t = 0, sannan ka lissafa nisoshin biyun ga kowannensu.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.hint.1: Yi amfani da hanyar baya kai tsaye ga layukan nan biyu, sannan ka bincika ko yanayi biyun suna yiwuwa.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.o.a: 1: layin da yake daidai tsakiyar layuka masu layi ɗaya biyun yana haɗuwa da x-axis a maki guda
z-m-34-06.s.s3.o.b: 2: kamar matsalar baya, maki biyu ne ke fitowa a kan x-axis
z-m-34-06.s.s3.r.b: A baya layukan biyu sun haɗu. Yi amfani da daidaito don bincika ko wurare biyu suna fitowa haka ma idan layukan sun yi layi ɗaya.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.o.c: 0: layuka biyu masu layi ɗaya ba sa haɗuwa, saboda haka babu wani maki mai tazara iri ɗaya.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.r.c: Rashin haɗuwa ya bambanta da rashin samun maki mai tazara iri ɗaya. Ka yi tunani game da tsakiyar tsakanin layuka biyu masu layi ɗaya.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.o.d: Marasa iyaka: idan layukan suna layi ɗaya, kowane maki yana da tazara iri ɗaya.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.r.d: Lissafa tazara biyun idan t = 0, sannan ka bincika ko da gaske sun yi daidai.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.explain: A cikin |3t − 12| = |3t + 8|, 3t − 12 = 3t + 8 ba ya yiwuwa, kuma 3t − 12 = −(3t + 8) yana ba da t = 2/3 kaɗai. Idan layukan suna layi ɗaya, ɗaya daga cikin yanayin da ake samu bayan cire alamar cikakkiyar ƙima yana ɓacewa, don haka adadin yana raguwa. Hasashen farko (2) yana canzawa bisa ga sharadin.

z-m-34-07.title: Idan asalin maƙasudi ya sa amsar ta zama ƙarya, shin yankin yana gefen kishiyar?
z-m-34-07.topic: Daidaiton siffofi: yankunan da layi da rashin daidaito suka raba (zaɓen maki na gwaji)
z-m-34-07.goal: Ka gano cewa maki na gwaji da ke kan layin iyaka ba zai iya nuna wane gefe ne yankin ba, sannan ka zaɓi yankin da maki na gwaji da ya dace.
z-m-34-07.material: Kana son nuna yankin da rashin daidaiton y > 2x ya wakilta a kan jirgin daidaito. Ga mafita ta Sangu a ƙasa. (An fara lissafa layukan daga 1.)
z-m-34-07.thinking.0: Nemo zato da aka ɓoye a cikin mafitar
z-m-34-07.thinking.1: Yanke hukunci game da sharuddan maki na gwaji
z-m-34-07.thinking.2: Daidaita mafitar sannan ka zaɓi yankin
z-m-34-07.prereq.1: Yadda ake zana layin y = 2x a kan jirgin daidaito
z-m-34-07.prereq.2: Ma’anar maki da ya cika rashin daidaito
z-m-34-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya da bai dace ba a cikin mafitar Sangu. (Wataƙila akwai layuka da yawa da ba su dace ba.)
z-m-34-07.s.s1.hint.0: Sanya lambobin da aka ambata a kowane layi, sannan ka bincika ko sun dace.
z-m-34-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bincika matsayin asalin maƙasudi dangane da layin y = 2x.
z-m-34-07.s.s1.line.0: Iyaka ita ce layin y = 2x, kuma alamar rashin daidaiton ba ta da alamar daidaito, saboda haka ka zana iyakar da layin dige-dige.
z-m-34-07.s.s1.line.1: Sanya asalin maƙasudi (0, 0) a matsayin maki na gwaji yana ba da 0 > 0, wanda ƙarya ne.
z-m-34-07.s.s1.line.2: Asalin maƙasudi bai cika rashin daidaiton ba, saboda haka yankin yana gefen kishiyar inda asalin yake.
z-m-34-07.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka yankin y > 2x yana ƙarƙashin layin.
z-m-34-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 bai dace ba. Asalin maƙasudi yana kan iyakar y = 2x, saboda haka babu wani abu da ake kira “gefen da asalin maƙasudi yake”. Kammalawar layi na 4 (ƙarƙashin layin) ma ba ta dace ba saboda wannan. Layuka na 1 da 2 sun dace.
z-m-34-07.s.s2.prompt: Don yanke shawarar gefen layin da yankin yake, zaɓi maki guda na gwaji ka saka shi cikin y > 2x. Zaɓi duk maki da za a iya amfani da su a matsayin maki na gwaji.
z-m-34-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, saka maƙasudin x ɗinsa cikin y = 2x, sannan ka kwatanta da maƙasudin y ɗinsa.
z-m-34-07.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi maki biyu da ba sa kan iyaka, sannan ka bincika ko sakamakonsu yana nuna gefe ɗaya.
z-m-34-07.s.s2.r.a: Asalin maƙasudi yana kan iyaka, saboda haka ba ya cikin kowane gefe.
z-m-34-07.s.s2.r.b: Wannan maki ma yana cika y = 2x, saboda haka yana kan iyaka. Ba zai iya nuna maka wane gefe ne yankin ba.
z-m-34-07.s.s2.explain: Kowane maki da ba ya kan iyakar y = 2x zai iya zama maki na gwaji. Ga (1, 0), 0 > 2 ƙarya ne, saboda haka gefe na kishiya (sama) shi ne yankin; ga (−1, 1), 1 > −2 gaskiya ne, saboda haka wannan gefe (sama) shi ne yankin. Sakamakon maki biyun yana nuna yanki ɗaya.
z-m-34-07.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta inda mafitar Sangu ta yi kuskure, sannan ka zaɓi maki na gwaji da za ka yi amfani da shi maimakon asalin maƙasudi don yanke shawarar gefen layin da yankin yake.
z-m-34-07.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko, rubuta ko maki na gwajin da aka zaɓa ya sa y > 2x ya zama gaskiya ko ƙarya.
z-m-34-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi amfani da wannan: idan gaskiya ne, gefen da maki na gwaji yake shi ne yankin; idan ƙarya ne, gefen kishiyar shi ne yankin.
z-m-34-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Na bincika cewa maki na gwajin da na zaɓa ba ya kan iyaka?

z-m-34-11.title: Idan aka juya gangaren a sama da ƙasa, shin layin da aka nuna madubi ne?
z-m-34-11.topic: Ma'aunan siffofi: nuna layi ta fuskar y = x (kwatanta hanyoyi biyu)
z-m-34-11.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi biyu na nemo hoton madubin layi ta fuskar y = x, yanke shawarar wacce za a iya dogara da ita, sannan ka nemo ka bayyana yanayin da ƙa'idar 'ɗauki kishiyar gangare' ba ta aiki (layi a kwance).
z-m-34-11.material: A ɗauka l' shi ne layin da aka samu ta nuna madubin layi l: y = 2x + 1 ta fuskar y = x. Gaon ya ce, "Maki (x, y) a kan l yana koma (y, x), saboda haka kawai a musanya x da y a ma'aunin," sai ya samu y = (x − 1)/2. Jian ya ce, "Gangaren yana zama kishiyarsa, kuma tsayin y-intercept bai canza," sai ya samu y = x/2 + 1. Gangaren sakamakon biyun iri ɗaya ne, amma ma'aunansu sun bambanta.

z-m-34-12.title: Shin mafi ƙarancin nisa tsakanin da'ira da layi koyaushe nisa ne a cire radius?
z-m-34-12.topic: Ma'aunan siffofi: mafi ƙarami da mafi girman nisa tsakanin maki a da'ira da layi
z-m-34-12.goal: Yanke hukunci yadda ƙa'idar 'cire radius daga nisan tsakiya zuwa layi' ke canzawa gwargwadon matsayin layi da da'ira, sannan ka tsara ƙa'idodin mafi ƙarami da mafi girma tare da sharuddansu.
z-m-34-12.material: Akwai da'ira C: (x − 1)² + (y − 1)² = 4 (tsakiya (1, 1), radius 2) da layi l_k: x + y = k. Kana son gano yadda nisa daga maki P zuwa layi l_k ke canzawa yayin da P ke motsi a kan da'ira. Haeun ya san ƙa'idar nan: "Mafi ƙaranci shi ne (nisa daga tsakiya zuwa layi) − (radius)." Nisa daga tsakiya (1, 1) zuwa layi x + y = k ita ce |2 − k| / √2.
